title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (6/20): The South–North Water Transfer Project
note_en: In written Chinese, 为了…而… links a purpose to an action: 中国为了解决北方缺水问题而修建的大型调水工程 "a huge water project China built in order to solve the north's water shortage." English puts the purpose after the verb ("built to solve"), but Chinese states the purpose first with 为了 and then uses 而 as a bridge to the action itself.
